info.name: Helius API Catalog Addresses Transactions API
Returns an enhanced transaction history for a given address

params.name: api-key
params.description: Helius API key. Obtain from https://dashboard.helius.dev or via `helius signup --json`.

params.name: before-signature
params.description: Start searching backwards from this transaction signature.

params.name: after-signature
params.description: Start searching forwards from this transaction signature.

params.name: commitment
params.description: How finalized a block must be to be included in the search. If not provided, will default to "finalized" commitment. Note that "processed" level commitment is not supported.

params.name: token-accounts
params.description: Filter transactions for related token accounts. Controls whether to include transactions involving token accounts owned by the address.

params.name: sort-order
params.description: The order to sort the results in.

params.name: gt-slot
params.description: Only return transactions with a slot greater than this value.

params.name: gte-slot
params.description: Only return transactions with a slot greater than or equal to this value.

params.name: lt-slot
params.description: Only return transactions with a slot less than this value.

params.name: lte-slot
params.description: Only return transactions with a slot less than or equal to this value.

params.name: gt-time
params.description: Only return transactions with a block time greater than this value.

params.name: gte-time
params.description: Only return transactions with a block time greater than or equal to this value.

params.name: lt-time
params.description: Only return transactions with a block time less than this value.

params.name: lte-time
params.description: Only return transactions with a block time less than or equal to this value.

params.name: address
params.description: The address to query for.

params.name: source
params.description: The TransactionSource to filter by. For a list of possible options, see the Transaction Types section.

params.name: type
params.description: The TransactionType to filter by. For a list of possible options, see the Transaction Types section.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of transactions to retrieve. The value should be between 1 and 100.

items.docs:
Access comprehensive transaction history for any Solana address with human-readable 
decoded data. Filter by transaction types, sources, and time ranges to get detailed
insights into wallet activity with context and decoded instructions.
